title: The Birth of John the Baptist
description: Elizabeth gives birth to a son in her old age. When the child is to be circumcised on the eighth day, Elizabeth insists on the name John, and Zechariah confirms this by writing it on a tablet. Immediately he regains his speech and praises God in a prophetic hymn about the child's calling as prophet of the Most High.

versions.title: The Birth of John the Baptist
versions.description: Elizabeth gives birth to her son John in her old age. Zechariah, who had been mute since the angel's message, regains his ability to speak and prophesies about the child's future.
